subject: storage.records

recordTypes.summary: Portable rules governing one retained artifact placement and its required index record.

fields.summary: The exact human-readable storage policy title.
Whether every exact placement batch requires operator confirmation.
Whether every retained shared artifact requires one document-index record.
Whether existing artifact moves remain exact human instructions rather than Automation effects.
Whether Automation may rename an existing stored artifact.
Whether Automation may delete an existing artifact or shortcut.
The default filed form for externally owned artifacts.
The filed form used only when a frozen snapshot is explicitly required.
The registered provisional destination used when no defensible home is selected.
The maximum bounded document-index candidates inspected before create.

content.summary: The normalized filing rules contain no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: One exact registered storage destination that Automation may name but never invent.

fields.summary: The stable configuration-scoped destination key.
The human-readable destination label.
The exact provider-neutral folder resource identity.
The exact provider-neutral containing drive identity.
Whether this is a normal home or the explicit provisional inbox.
The closed subject-area keys that may resolve to this location.
The exact document categories associated with this location.

content.summary: Storage locations contain identity and classification facts only.

recordTypes.summary: One exact stored artifact observed before any placement or human move decision.

fields.summary: The exact observed artifact name.
The exact provider-neutral artifact resource identity.
The observed file, folder, or shortcut kind.
Whether the artifact is organization-owned or externally owned.
The exact canonical artifact link used by the document index.
The exact currently observed parent locations.
The exact target of a shortcut when the artifact is a shortcut.

content.summary: Artifact content is outside the filing decision and is never loaded by this model.

limitations: This model defines portable storage meaning only; provider identifiers, current location membership, permissions, and connected behavior require an Integration observation.
Retention judgment remains human-owned, and no record type grants move, rename, delete, placement, approval, or execution authority.
